body:
Ethan Ops: inbound FRA consignment (20 A100s). Vendor emailed: 2 units failed QC (power) and one serial mismatch. AWB: FRX-331122. Can we do partial-release?
Priya SCM: contract SLA 5bd. Vendor offering 48h express for +€3,300. Loaner pool check before pay?
Marco (ShipIt): ShipIt here  AWB FRX-331122 contains 17 clear +3 flagged. Flagged: A100-7710 (power), A100-7711 (power), A100-771X (serial mismatch). We can split-ship replacements next day if approved. RMA RX-FRX331122.
Lina Crossdock: crossdock: will tag `HOLD-QC` on the 3. Need vendor to confirm EORI on replacement AWB otherwise customs may hold.
Ethan Ops: prefer partial-release of 17 -> staging-FRA and hold 3. Canary needs 4 A100; loss of 3 reduces capacity but manageable if we get replacements in 48h.
Priya SCM: loaner pool shows 1 A100 in region, not enough. Recommend express.
finance-bot: finance-bot: express (€3,300) < estimated SLA exposure. Approve up to €3,500 for express RMA. Charge code: INFRA-GPU-EU.
Marco (ShipIt): scheduling express pickup, will post replacement AWB ts 3771230120. Prepaid RMA label attached in vendor email.
Lina Crossdock: manifest snippet pushed, holds applied:
unit,serial,location,status
A100,A100-7601,staging-fra,ready
A100,A100-7602,staging-fra,ready
A100,A100-7710,crossdock-fra,hold-qc-power
A100,A100-7711,crossdock-fra,hold-qc-power
A100,A100-771X,crossdock-fra,hold-serial-mismatch
Ethan Ops: holding canary rollout for 6h. Closing unless vendor misses ETA or customs flags EORI.
